company.name: ATM GROUP
company.address: A/P. Karegaon, Tal. Shirur, Dist. Pune, Maharashtra – 412220

about: ATM GROUP is a professionally managed organization providing contractual manpower, cargo transport and operational support for industrial and corporate environments. The organization supports clients with skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled manpower, contract labour deployment and logistics-oriented services.

divisions.name: Manpower Solutions
divisions.description: Skilled, semi-skilled, unskilled and technical workforce deployment.

divisions.name: Logistics & Cargo
divisions.description: Cargo transport, material movement and logistics-oriented operational support.

divisions.name: Facility Management
divisions.description: Housekeeping, gardening, security, pest control and guest-house support.

divisions.name: Staffing & Placement
divisions.description: Recruitment, placement and staffing support aligned with client requirements.

divisions.name: Industrial Support
divisions.description: Labour contracting, material handling, job work and electrical maintenance.

divisions.name: Supply & Services
divisions.description: Catering, scrap material and computer accessory supply services.

vision: To be a trusted, disciplined and leading organization in contract manpower and cargo transport, supporting industries, factories and businesses with dependable workforce and safe, timely transportation while building long-term collaboration.
mission: To provide reliable contract manpower and efficient cargo transport so industries can operate smoothly, safely and on schedule, with manpower aligned to client requirements and transport delivered safely, timely and cost-effectively.
whyUs: Scalable manpower for short-term and long-term requirements
PF, ESI and statutory compliance focused operations
Trained and disciplined workforce with safety and productivity focus
